name: Analog xNode 4x4 stereo line I/O (Livewire+/AES67)
source: Telos Alliance legacy xNode pages (rear labels from Telos product photos) and Axia xNode Installation & User's Guide rev 2.0
notes: Fanless half-rack 1RU Livewire+/AES67 audio node (legacy; replaced by xNode2). Front: OLED status/setup display, two soft buttons and a power LED (green AC, red PoE, orange both). Network: two 100BT RJ45 ports, NET 1 (top) takes IEEE 802.3af PoE, used as redundant mirrored ports or as Livewire plus a separate management port. Power: auto-ranging 90-240 VAC 50/60 Hz IEC inlet and/or PoE, 14 W. 216 x 44 x 298 mm (8.5 x 1.72 x 11.75 in); net weight not published (3.2 kg shipping). Two fit side by side in 1RU with the xNode rack-mount kit 2011-00076; surface-mount kit 2011-00077. 4 stereo (8 mono) balanced line inputs and 4 stereo line outputs, also usable as 5.1 plus a stereo mix. Inputs switch between -10 dBV and +4 dBu; outputs reach +24 dBu. The same 4 stereo inputs and 4 stereo outputs appear in parallel on the RJ45 jacks (one stereo pair per jack: pins 1/2 left +/-, 3/6 right +/-, 4 ground) and on the two DB25s (8 balanced channels each, Tascam/AES59 pinout), so wire one or the other. Rear, left to right: DB25 inputs over DB25 outputs, RJ45 inputs 1-4 over outputs 1-4, NET 1 over NET 2, IEC.

source: Telos Alliance legacy xNode pages (rear labels from Telos product photos) and Axia xNode Installation & User's Guide rev 2.0
notes: Fanless half-rack 1RU Livewire+/AES67 audio node (legacy; replaced by xNode2). Front: OLED status/setup display, two soft buttons and a power LED (green AC, red PoE, orange both). name: SDI xNode 2-channel SDI audio embedder/de-embedder (Livewire+/AES67)
source: Telos Alliance legacy SDI xNode page and Linear Acoustic SDI xNode manual (rear labels from Telos product photo)
notes: Legacy Linear Acoustic SDI xNode (replaced by the SDI AoIP Node). Two 3G/HD/SD-SDI inputs de-embed up to 8 pairs each to Livewire+/AES67, and two SDI outputs re-embed up to 8 pairs from the network. Fanless half-rack 1RU, same chassis and rack kit as the other xNodes. Front: OLED meters/display, two buttons, status LED. Network: two 10/100 RJ45 (NET 1, NET 2; redundant or Livewire plus management). Power: 90-240 VAC IEC (0.2 A) plus a locking +12 VDC backup input; 15-18 W max. 216 x 44 x 298 mm. Rear, left to right: SDI 1 In/Out, SDI 2 In/Out, +12VDC Backup In, NET 1 over NET 2, IEC.

name: SDI AoIP Node 2-channel 3G-SDI embedder/de-embedder (AES67)
source: Telos Alliance SDI AoIP Node page, brochure and docs.telosalliance.com front/rear panel overview (rear from Telos product photo)
notes: Successor to the SDI xNode. Full-width 1RU. Two 3G/HD/SD-SDI inputs de-embed up to 8 pairs each to AES67, two SDI outputs re-embed up to 8 pairs. Reference: PTP (AES67), SDI or internal 48 kHz. Front: four status LEDs (PWR 1, PWR 2, status, sync), colour LCD, five-button navigation cluster. Rear, left to right: GPI/O DB15 female (5 in / 5 out, not supported in firmware 1.2.006), AES in/out holes (blanked in Telos photo, not listed in the docs, so not added as ports), SDI 1 Out/In, SDI 2 Out/In, AES67 and CONTROL gigabit RJ45, PWR 1 and PWR 2 IEC (dual internal redundant 95-240 VAC supplies, 30 W max). 483 x 229 x 45 mm (19 x 9 x 1.75 in), 2.72 kg.

name: xNode rack-mount kit (2 xNodes, xNode2s or SDI xNodes in 1RU)
source: Telos Alliance legacy xNode pages (rear labels from Telos product photos) and Axia xNode Installation & User's Guide rev 2.0
